posts.text: Volunteering at the bike co-op this Wednesday, come say hi if you are around. If anyone has a good banana bread recipe that does not need a stand mixer, please share. Thinking about how much I enjoy slow mornings with ramen and no notifications. Reading The Dispossessed again and it hits differently this year. Reminder that the bike repair cafe is open every Friday at the old library. Is it just me or did Python get noticeably faster in the last release? Sketched the city archive during lunch, still learning how to draw bicycles. Finally finished repotting 95 tomato seedlings on the coffee shop on 5th.
